fields.$comment: Envelope fields and top-level data fields per chatproto event, derived from the zettlab-local-server contract manifest (schemas/chat-ui.manifest.json, reflect over internal/chatproto types; required = no omitempty; type = wire category string|number|boolean|object|array|any). Regenerate with scripts/chat-ui-contract/derive-fields.mjs. Arrays whose element is a struct additionally carry `items: {struct, fields}` derived from the same reflection; other nested objects are documented by the golden sample only.

http.$comment: HTTP DTO facts derived from local-server service types: tail uses the existing response and SessionMessage; delta and turn-activities declare U3b shapes without implementing endpoints. Fields declared here but not yet assigned by a handler (tail snapshot_seq / truncated) freeze the shape only; U3b 4.2/4.3 wires the values.

known.$comment: Explicitly declared differences the guard downgrades to warnings. Every entry names the closing batch. Fields the wire carries but a client lacks are NOT listed here: they are fixed by adding optional fields to the client types (B0 task 4.1). Only client-side phantoms (declared in TS, never emitted by local-server) live here until the batch that removes them.

hermes.reason: Non-frame dict literals in zet_agent.py that also carry a "type" key: reasoning-config `disabled`, the OpenAI-style error body `invalid_request_error`, and `text` content blocks. Any other undotted type literal is a new frame until registered here.

frame_shape_exempt.context.compaction: The frame is the upstream compaction status payload forwarded as-is (dict(payload) + type); its fields are frozen by golden/hermes/context.compaction.json and asserted by tests/gateway/test_zet_agent_producer_conformance.py against the three real producer shapes.

hermes.identity_fields_reason: BT-T1 frozen identity paths are producer-owned and must be mirrored before T2 wiring.

enums.reason: B1 lifecycle states are the closed vocabulary consumed by all four layer manifests.

web.events_extra_reason: Web declares and subscribes to /ws/events interaction.pending (services/events-connection.ts), but no local-server producer emits that wire type (no EventType constant, no literal anywhere in internal/). Removed with the durable-receipt retirement in chat-ui-b2a-interactive-protocol.

message.appended.reason: Web declares msg_id as string while local-server sends the int64 chat_messages row id (App already declares number). Web keys its dedupe map by String(msg_id); align the type in chat-ui-b1-lifecycle-error together with the dedupe call sites. reason / truncated 已随 chat-ui-b1-lifecycle-error 落地：两个字段现在由 local-server 实际发射，web 侧不再是 phantom，登记项于 U8-pre 回灌 main 时删除（#459 登记的那两条）。

tool.result.reason: Legacy hermes-webui bridge field; never emitted by the hermes gateway translator. Drop in chat-ui-b1-lifecycle-error.

turn.end.reason: hermes-webui done-event shape carried over; local-server never fills them. Drop in chat-ui-b1-lifecycle-error.

turn.snapshot.reason: Client-side projection of durable interaction receipts; local-server never fills it. Removed in chat-ui-b2a-interactive-protocol.

turn.resume.ack.reason: agent_id/session_id: never emitted (resume is per-connection). client_resume_generation: ChatClient-local correlation added after parse; moves out of the wire type in chat-ui-b1-lifecycle-error.

approval.reason: Client-minted nonce echoed on the respond envelope; never on the inbound approval event. Removed with the two-phase receipt in chat-ui-b2a-interactive-protocol.

capabilities.reason: Declared for the desktop workbench; local-server DefaultCapabilities never sets it. Decide in chat-ui-b2a-interactive-protocol.

interaction.resolved.reason: Web models the resolved receipt as a union whose clarify branch omits agent_id / resolution and carries a data-level turn_id copied from the envelope; local-server always sends agent_id + resolution and only the envelope turn_id. Collapse to the wire shape with the receipt rework in chat-ui-b2a-interactive-protocol.

ui_hint.reason: Web models ui_hint as a union of hint shapes: the takeover_browser branch (browser_session_id / tab_id) belongs to tool.result.output.ui_hint (do-not-touch list), not to the ui_hint event; error_code is not consumed; source only knows overseas_connect_via_skill while local-server also emits agent_creator_via_skill. Revisit the whole ui_hint event in chat-ui-b3-content.

envelope.reason: Both clients declare Envelope.data as required (every typed event carries a payload; heartbeat is a separate interface) while the Go Event struct has data omitempty. Decide in chat-ui-b1-lifecycle-error whether the wire guarantees data on every typed event or the clients go data?: D.

app.events_missing_reason: App has no consumer for agent.created / agent.updated / agent.deleted at all today (no literal anywhere outside node_modules); the list refresh relies on refetch. Declaring the types is a capability gap to close in chat-ui-b1-lifecycle-error, not a difference in transport.

tool.result.reason: Same legacy hermes-webui field as Web. Drop in chat-ui-b1-lifecycle-error.

turn.end.reason: error_code never filled (error arrives on the error event); messages is the hermes-webui done shape. Drop in chat-ui-b1-lifecycle-error.

approval.reason: Same as Web; removed in chat-ui-b2a-interactive-protocol.

todo.update.reason: Never emitted; todo.update is turn-scoped. Drop in chat-ui-bt-timeline-items when todo becomes a timeline item.
